cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: FORM FACE vs FILENAME: the file is named '..._12_Final_...' and the clerk listing calls it a Summary Report, but the only box checked is YEAR-END REPORT (January 31); the Final / Dissolution box is NOT checked. This 2012-vintage form has no top-row 'Office' box (only Political Party) and labels Column B 'Year to Date' rather than 'Aggregate Total'. Arithmetic self-consistent.

LISTING LABEL DISAGREES WITH THE FORM: the index/filename says 'Final', but the cover's checked box is the YEAR-END REPORT ('January 31 of each year'); the FINAL / DISSOLUTION box is NOT checked and the amendment question is left unanswered.
